entries.headline: Kyle Stowers connected at +500
entries.story: Kyle Stowers cashed. Facing Aaron Nola, he went deep in the 1st in his 1st at bat. The call: "Kyle Stowers homers (14) on a fly ball to right center field." Final line: 1-for-3 with 1 BB.

entries.headline: Michael Busch stayed in the yard
entries.story: Michael Busch went 1-for-5 with 1 RBI against Michael McGreevy and the St. Louis Cardinals. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Ryan Waldschmidt came close
entries.story: Ryan Waldschmidt went 2-for-4 against Bubba Chandler and the Pittsburgh Pirates. Closest call was a double in the 6th: "Ryan Waldschmidt doubles (13) on a sharp fly ball to center fielder Jake Mangum. James McCann to 3rd." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Ketel Marte came close
entries.story: Ketel Marte went 1-for-6 against Bubba Chandler and the Pittsburgh Pirates. Closest call was a double in the 5th: "Ketel Marte doubles (21) on a sharp line drive to right fielder Esmerlyn Valdez." The power showed up; the carry did not.
